title: Design Services for CSMS Concrete Replacement Project
short_description: Design and construction administration for concrete replacement at Camp Williams CSMS.
project_scope: Concrete replacement project for the Camp Williams Combined Support and Maintenance Shop (CSMS). The notice indicates a rehabilitation/refurbishment project at an existing building facility, but provides no technical quantities, areas, spans, or detailed structural characteristics.
services: A/E services from design through construction administration in accordance with the DFD Policy and Procedure Manual for Architects/Engineers and Consultants and the DFD AE Contract for Professional Services; requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing building concrete replacement/rehabilitation with no indication of special structural complexity.
- Primarily a general building refurbishment project, which is only of limited relevance to sbp.
- No long spans, bridge works, special structures, stadiums, or architecturally demanding features are described.
- Includes civil engineering, but the scope appears routine and building-focused rather than innovative structural design.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the notice. Only the total construction cost of 699.3K USD is provided.
references_qualifications: The notice states that the Department of Military Affairs seeks an A/E to provide design through construction administration services. Specific reference counts, qualification thresholds, or comparable project requirements are not stated in the provided text.

notes: Project number: 26D2D-. Agency ID: 64074. Target market listed as General Building. Stage: RFP/RFQ. The source marks the opportunity as time sensitive. No detailed procurement criteria or technical documents are included in the provided text.
